properties.description: GDevelop port of FOUND, referenced directly against checkpoint/current-progress.

inlineCode:
root.innerHTML=`
F
FOUND COLLECTOR NETWORK

COLLECTOR ACCESS

Sign in to your collector account or create one to continue into FOUND. Your username is your public collector identity.

Your collection and progress are saved to this collector account.Your password is handled by the FOUND authentication service. Usernames are public and must follow FOUND community standards.
`;

const req=async(url,opt={})=>{const r=await fetch(url,{...opt,headers:{apikey:K,"Content-Type":"application/json",...(opt.headers||{})}});const t=await r.text();let d=null;try{d=t?JSON.parse(t):null}catch{d=t}if(!r.ok)throw new Error(d?.msg||d?.message||d?.error_description||d?.error||`Request failed (${r.status})`);return d;};

const run=async mode=>{const username=root.querySelector("#fgUser").value.trim(),email=root.querySelector("#fgEmail").value.trim(),password=root.querySelector("#fgPass").value;if(mode==="create"&&!username){st.textContent="Choose a public username to create your account.";return}if(!email.includes("@")){st.textContent="Enter a valid email address.";return}if(password.length<8){st.textContent="Password must be at least 8 characters.";return}try{if(mode==="signin"){st.textContent="Signing in…";const s=await req(`${U}/auth/v1/token?grant_type=password`,{method:"POST",body:JSON.stringify({email,password})});if(!s?.access_token)throw new Error("Sign in did not return a session.");await finish(s);}else{st.textContent="Checking username…";const rows=await req(`${U}/rest/v1/rpc/username_status`,{method:"POST",body:JSON.stringify({p_username:username})});const c=Array.isArray(rows)?rows[0]:rows;if(!c?.ok||!c?.available)throw new Error(c?.reason||"That username is not available.");st.textContent="Creating your collector account…";const s=await req(`${U}/auth/v1/signup?redirect_to=${encodeURIComponent("found://auth/confirmed")}`,{method:"POST",body:JSON.stringify({email,password,data:{username,display_name:username}})});if(s?.access_token)await finish(s);else st.textContent="Account created. Check your email to confirm it. The confirmation link will reopen FOUND.";}}catch(e){st.textContent=e?.message||String(e)}};root.querySelector("#fgSignIn").onclick=()=>run("signin");root.querySelector("#fgCreate").onclick=()=>run("create");
